payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP on DAG with state (node, visited_count) storing min time. Iterates over counts 2..n and nodes, updating from incoming edges. Reconstructs path from dp table.
payload.rationale: State dimension includes both current node and number of visited nodes, making it a 2D DP. Code initializes base from node 1 and iterates counts up to n, distinct from 1D DP. Fits dp_2d_state exactly.
